prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 2 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 6 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: INT. SU YAQING'S DINING AREA, Day, daylight through the window on the left wall.
Image 1: the character sheet of Lin Qingyu (21), look S0
Image 2: the location INT. SU YAQING'S DINING AREA, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 3: the location INT. SU YAQING'S DINING AREA, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 4: the location INT. SU YAQING'S DINING AREA, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location INT. SU YAQING'S DINING AREA, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 6: the location INT. SU YAQING'S DINING AREA, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 7: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 8: the prop call phone; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Lin Qingyu sits in the grey upholstered chair at the window end of the white marble dining table, beside the large window on the left wall. He wears the white cotton hoodie with its sleeves pushed up, the beige drawstring joggers and white sneakers. He holds the black call phone in one hand. On the table are one glass vase of white daisies and one bottle of red wine. The walnut sideboard stands against the back wall, and the open archway to the living room is on the right wall. Camera side: in front of the table, on the plant and wine cabinet side, facing the sideboard.
Panel 1: Wide shot, fast push in, eye level, from the wine cabinet facing the table and the sideboard. The sunlit dining area with daisies and red wine on the marble table. Lin Qingyu sits at the window end and raises the phone to his ear, and his smile fades.
Panel 2: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the table's near side. Lin Qingyu glances toward the archway on the right wall, his expression serious, the phone at his ear.
Panel 3: Close-up, slow push in, eye level, from the table's near side. Lin Qingyu's eyes narrow with quiet determination.
Panel 4: Medium shot, locked-off camera, low angle, from the near side of the marble table past the daisies. Lin Qingyu leans forward and lays his free hand flat on the marble table beside the vase of daisies.
Panel 5: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, high angle, from the wine cabinet side. Lin Qingyu keeps his lips closed while he listens. His brow tightens and his fingers tap the marble once.
Panel 6: Close-up, locked-off camera, low angle, from the table's near side. Lin Qingyu cuts in without hesitation, and a faint confident smile touches his lips.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
